description: The synchronous response to a SemanticSearchRequest. Contains the ranked hits plus a small amount of provenance so the caller (typically the Bedrock agent) can summarize how the result was retrieved.

searchIndexId.description: Echo of the SearchIndex id the request targeted.

mode.description: Echo of the retrieval mode used. May differ from the request mode if validation downgraded HYBRID or SEMANTIC to KEYWORD because no semantic-enriched columns were available — the downgrade is reflected here so the caller can surface it.

hits.description: Ranked hits in descending score order, capped at the request's topK.

enrichedColumns.description: The semantic-enriched columns on the target SearchIndex that were searched (after applying the request's columnFilter). Empty when mode is KEYWORD. Lets the agent explain which columns drove a SEMANTIC or HYBRID match.
